keyPoints.en: Force has size and direction, and is measured in newtons.
keyPoints.bm: Daya ada magnitud dan arah, dan diukur dalam newton.

keyPoints.en: Weight is the gravitational force on a mass.
keyPoints.bm: Berat ialah daya graviti pada jisim.

keyPoints.en: Types: friction, normal reaction, buoyancy, tension.
keyPoints.bm: Jenis: geseran, tindak balas normal, apungan, tegangan.

question.en: Is mass the same on the Moon?

tip.en: Do not give weight in kilograms.

keyPoints.en: A force can change motion or shape.
keyPoints.bm: Daya boleh mengubah gerakan atau bentuk.

keyPoints.en: A larger distance from a pivot gives a larger moment.
keyPoints.bm: Jarak lebih jauh dari fulkrum memberi momen lebih besar.

keyPoints.en: A smaller area gives a higher pressure.
keyPoints.bm: Luas lebih kecil memberi tekanan lebih tinggi.

meaning.en: A bar that turns on a pivot.

tip.en: Convert cm to m before finding a moment in N m.
tip.bm: Tukar cm kepada m sebelum mencari momen dalam N m.
